name: cg-dynamics
notes: Canonical CG Production House company-account connector. Single communal connection for the whole CG Production House ChatGPT account, OAuth-connected once as the shared company admin. There is deliberately NO per-staff and NO per-client connector or app id. The OAuth principal is the connection principal only; the effective staff/client subject comes from the per-call Project context contract (see ../PROJECT-CONTEXT.md, #319). No client secret, client id, or callback URL belongs in this file.
